_comment: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash's causal encoder-decoder layout at nano scale: an all-attention stack (ratio 0) whose second half reads K/V from named first-half layers, plus Engram memory and MTP. V4.1 pairs this with the hierarchical DSA indexer on MLA (--index-modes); that needs attn=mla, which cannot share K/V here, so this preset shows the encoder-decoder half.
